title: sail
intention: The BUILD skill: /sail <something> runs the voyage a charted request earns — template-fills from the /chart chain's deepest berth (refuses to build from the conversation), requires a cast ticket (/sorted owns casting), and carries the whole build liturgy as numbered skill-steps: BUILDME crossing -> build inside the bounds (constrain = hard edges; survey holdings composed, absences built minimal) -> prove twice -> PROVEME + tester seal -> live fire -> PROVED + records settled (+ recompile poke on charter deltas) -> deposit learnings -> commit/push verified by instrument -> CLOSE THE BOUNDARY: /saveslate, then invite /compact. The same close lands as /sorted step 6 in the same act (one ruling, two doors).
why: The ratified pattern from the daemons correction: CC-discipline into skill-STEPS, not personal habit (Law 4). The build liturgy has lived in memory files and habit — varying by session, model, hour; behind the slash-door it fires the same way every time (Akien's measured skill-door facts). The /saveslate-then-/compact close makes compaction SAFE by construction: the slate is the durable half, so what /compact drops is provably scaffolding. NAMING, flagged as CC's coinage: you chart a course, then you SAIL it — ship vocabulary beside chart/charter/voyage/berth/harbor, and the record already calls the BUILDME->PROVED journey a voyage, which /sail runs; 'whatever it shall be called' delegated the working name, rename is one mv + re-symlink.
traces_to: Law 4 — a discipline that matters moves down the ladder: habit -> skill-step -> physics; this ticket is the middle rung for the whole build liturgy
Law 1 — the settled build sequence compiled once into steps, not re-derived (and re-varied) per session
Law 5 — the close (slate + compact) keeps the voyage's story durable at every boundary
telos — get Akien out of running the system: the liturgy fires without him prompting each step

falsifier.proves_green: the /challenge cadence on the prose; the cairnmap recompile gate (charter written beside it, gate poked); the real gate is downstream — chokepoint build gate, tester seal, berth doors already enforce most steps by physics. Live gate: the first /sail crossing runs end to end without a skipped step.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a /sail build filling from the conversation while berths existed; a constrain bound silently widened; a survey holding rebuilt in parallel; 'done' without instrument verification; a build-boundary compact with no slate before it. WRONG-SHAPE: steps routinely skipped without a red anywhere means the discipline needs the next rung down (physics).
falsifier.horizon: re-read at the first real /sail crossing (the proof event); when a middle stage (decompose...) lands and the fill deepens; when Akien names or renames the skill; if a third skill wants the /saveslate-/compact close (it becomes a shared fragment then, earned not merged).
